pages.title: Your onboarding
pages.subtitle: Five stages from sign-up to your first text — who does what and when.

blocks.note: From sign-up to your first text

rows.label: Welcome & kickoff
rows.note: Attend with your points of contact, use case, user counts, and ideal live date.

rows.label: Compliance & registration
rows.note: Send us the checklist below. Ask us to review your opt-in form first.

rows.label: Account setup
rows.note: Confirm your user list, numbers, and integrations (HubSpot, Aircall, RingCentral).

rows.label: Training
rows.note: Book the admin and group sessions and get your team on them.

rows.label: Go-live & support
rows.note: Start texting and bring anything you need to your Customer Success Manager.

blocks.title: Compliance is the gate
blocks.text: You can't send texts or calls until your business is carrier-approved (10DLC or Toll-Free). Getting us your details early and accurate is the single biggest way to go live faster.

pages.title: Clear the
pages.subtitle: Bring these to Stage 2 and you'll go live faster.

blocks.heading: What to bring to Stage 2
blocks.intro: Have these ready to clear the compliance gate fast.

rows.definition: Exactly as they appear on your IRS documents.
An active site with a Privacy Policy, SMS consent language, and Terms.
How people agree to your texts: web form, paper, keyword, or QR code.
What you'll send, plus real examples with your brand name.
Who needs access and whether you're bringing existing numbers.
The CRM and tools you want connected.

blocks.title: A rejection isn't a dead end
blocks.text: If carriers reject something, we tell you what to change and resubmit for you. Common causes: a name mismatch, a new EIN, or a bundled opt-in form.

items.question: Not sure which stage you're in?
items.answer: Ask your Onboarding Manager or CSM — they can tell you your stage and what's outstanding.

items.question: Want your opt-in form checked first?
items.answer: Send it over before you submit. A two-minute review can save days.

items.question: What integrations are supported?
items.answer: HubSpot, Aircall, RingCentral and other CRM and calling tools — confirm yours at kickoff.
